answer: Require every agent to post a bond locked to a unique, slowly earned reputation, then slash that bond if agents coordinate to claim the same reward or break a task’s rules. A Sybil attacker can still create many identities, but each must tie up real capital, and laundering reputation takes time; splitting one stake across an orchard of accounts does not multiply its weight. The meadow may look crowded, yet each rewarded action must carry its own costly thread of collateral, so cheap identities cannot cheaply outvote honest agents.
